title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash d53eda7a637c… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash d53eda7a637c99cc7fb566d96e9fa109bf15c478410a3f5eb4d4c4e26cd081f6 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-10-24. The file is associated with attacker activity involving the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer). The payload could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. The file was seen originating from attacker infrastructure in Poland. There is no information about active exploitation or affected software versions. This indicator should be matched against files in environments and security tools for detection purposes.
